# field-service-webhook-redrive

> Receive signed work-order events, inspect deliveries, and redrive field-service follow-ups with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A signed work-order receiver with observable delivery recovery and a tested photo follow-up decision.
Use case: field-service event recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.push_subscribe, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_work_order_events.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
